question: Where do cgo transitions, Go CPU samples, Go allocation objects and bytes, and Linux software-event samples occur in the six retained coordinator scan workloads on the exact accepted implementation?

claims.text: Each successful attempt is bound to the exact accepted source and binary, preserves the registered correctness digest, and retains the profiler or counter artifact required by its registered mode.
claims.if_supported: The retained profiles may be used to select a separately preregistered engineering candidate.
claims.if_not_supported: Classify the session incomplete_diagnostic or wrong_answer and make no attribution claim.

claims.text: This single-implementation profiling diagnostic does not measure, support, reject, or estimate a production speedup.

arms.description: Exact accepted coordinator with no profiler; only the loop-bracketed process-wide runtime.NumCgoCall delta is interpreted.
The same binary with loop-bracketed runtime/pprof CPU sampling in a fresh process.

parameters.profile_boundary: after fixture and before correctness hashing

arms.description: The same binary with one cumulative allocs profile after the loop in a fresh process; startup and fixture allocation remain included and disclosed, with rate one set immediately before the fixture.

parameters.profile_boundary: cumulative process startup, deterministic fixture, and operation loop; MemProfileRate=1 immediately before fixture

arms.description: The same binary under one fixed Linux perf stat software-event set in a fresh process; fixture costs remain included and disclosed.
The same binary under Linux perf record cpu-clock sampling at 99 Hz in a fresh process; fixture samples remain included and disclosed.

aa.not_applicable_reason: No arm-to-arm timing or effect comparison is made.

positive.not_applicable_reason: This is direct profiling of a fixed implementation, not a detector calibrated against a planted effect.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No null-population inference or negative-result claim is made.

factors.name: production source
factors.how: construct and hash one synthetic tree; add only the registered experiment overlay

factors.name: case
factors.value: three operations at 1024 and 8192 log entries
factors.how: all six cases run in every diagnostic mode

factors.name: toolchain and binary
factors.how: download/hash/build manifests and a pre-data binary-binding amendment

factors.name: host state
factors.how: record host, kernel, affinity, cgroup, PSI, steal, perf_event_paranoid, event sources and profiler versions per attempt

comparisons.reason: Each artifact is interpreted only within its own observer; no ratio is formed.
comparisons.threshold: Completeness and exact correctness only; no numerical promotion threshold.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Observer modes are not compared; fixed lexical case order and registered mode order make artifact accounting auditable.

instance_sampling.rule: Run the six retained cases in the README order in every mode.

blinding.how: Observer identity is required to parse each artifact; no effect comparison or threshold is analyzed.

power.note: Fixed one diagnostic artifact per case and observer; no inferential test, confidence interval, or effect threshold exists.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Conservative prospective bound from retained v7 operation costs; no new profile was run.

primary.name: process cgo calls per operation
primary.definition: runtime.NumCgoCall process-wide delta immediately around the fixed benchmark loop divided by b.N; fixture and correctness hashing excluded.

secondary.name: loop-bracketed Go CPU profile samples
secondary.definition: Samples in the CPU pprof started after fixture construction and stopped before correctness hashing.
secondary.source: Go CPU pprof sample count and stacks
secondary.resolution: one sample at the runtime profiler rate

secondary.name: cumulative allocation objects by stack
secondary.definition: alloc_objects in the cumulative fresh-process profile through startup, deterministic fixture construction, and the operation loop; rate one begins immediately before the fixture.
secondary.resolution: one allocation object for allocations sampled after the rate-one change; runtime-default sampling before it

secondary.name: cumulative allocation bytes by stack
secondary.definition: alloc_space bytes in the cumulative fresh-process profile through startup, deterministic fixture construction, and the operation loop; rate one begins immediately before the fixture.
secondary.resolution: one byte for allocations sampled after the rate-one change; runtime-default sampling before it

secondary.name: complete-process Linux software-event counts
secondary.definition: Raw task-clock, cpu-clock, context switches, CPU migrations and page faults for one complete fresh benchmark process, including fixture construction.
secondary.resolution: one event or profiler-reported clock resolution

secondary.name: complete-process perf cpu-clock samples
secondary.definition: cpu-clock samples at 99 Hz for one complete fresh benchmark process, including fixture construction.

secondary.name: registered operation result digest
secondary.definition: Post-loop digest of the version vector or ordered lines and reached vector, using the retained benchmark helpers.

record: CPU model/features, kernel, affinity, cgroup, hypervisor, steal, PSI and perf_event_paranoid
return code, stdout, stderr and SHA-256 for every required artifact

placement.status: must be hash-bound by a pre-data amendment

stopping_rules.rule: Before data, bind and commit the runner, analyzer, synthetic source archive, binary, Go/perf closures, backend placement, canonical exporter and exact commands; then register and freeze in separate commits.
Attempt exactly six cases by five modes in README order, one fresh process per cell, for 30 attempts, then stop.
Retain every timeout, non-zero exit, unavailable event, malformed profile, missing artifact and correctness mismatch once; never replace, extend or select attempts.
A correctness mismatch is terminal wrong_answer. Other missing/failed cells yield incomplete_diagnostic. Neither outcome authorizes a retry under this run ID.

decision_rule.text: Classify wrong_answer on any correctness mismatch; otherwise complete_diagnostic only when all 30 unique attempts and required hash-valid artifacts exist; otherwise incomplete_diagnostic. Emit stack/count distributions without thresholds, ratios, confidence intervals, or a speedup claim.
decision_rule.threshold: artifact completeness and exact correctness only
decision_rule.statistic: Per-case raw cgo delta and profiler/event stack distributions; no cross-arm statistic.
decision_rule.interval: none; single diagnostic artifacts are not inferential samples
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: none; observer outputs are absolute diagnostics

inadmissible: Treating ns/op, profiler duration, elapsed command time, sample share or a profile top entry as a speedup or regression.
Comparing observer modes numerically; their overhead and operation counts intentionally differ.
Describing the cumulative allocation profile as loop-only or removing startup/fixture stacks after seeing their size.
Selecting hardware PMU events after preflight, merging failed attempts, changing N, replacing a case, or adding a candidate after seeing a profile.
Using v9 timing rows or a profiled row in a future decisive A/B distribution.
Inferring that one cgo call has a fixed cost or that fewer calls must improve end-to-end latency without a separately frozen comparison.

graphs: per-case cgo calls and allocation/CPU/perf stack distributions, labeled diagnostic
